use.title: How you use NoCapOS
use.hint: The screen, other devices, or both. The switches below follow your choice.
use.bothText: NoCap Desktop on this screen, and NoCapOS in the browser on your other devices at home.
use.desktopText: NoCap Desktop on this screen. Other devices can't open NoCapOS.
use.webText: No desktop on this machine. Use NoCapOS from other devices' browsers.
